ios.desc:
This is a Trading Card Game Utility App.

Omi ~ TCG Card Value Scanner is the ultimate tool for collectors and players to scan, identify, and track trading cards with real-time price updates.

 No more manual lookups or missed opportunities — simply scan any Pokemon TCG card (from vintage Base Set to the newest expansion) and instantly see its current market value, detailed card info, and price trends. Whether you’re a casual collector or a serious trader, Omi ~ TCG Card Value Scanner helps you manage your collection and make informed decisions so you never overpay or miss a great deal.

Key Features of Omi ~ Pokemon TCG Card Value Scanner
Lightning-Fast Card Scanning: Advanced AI + OCR recognizes your cards instantly and pulls up all the details. Scan in any language — great for English, Japanese, and more.

Accurate Card Values: Up-to-date market prices and value trends at a glance, with multi-currency support.

Price History & Trends: Interactive charts show historical price data so you can time buys, sells, or grading decisions.

Collection Management: Build your library, organize by set, rarity, or custom decks, and track what you own (and what you’re missing) with a comprehensive set database.

Decks & Wishlists: Plan winning decks and keep a wishlist of target cards — deck building and collecting in one place.

PSA Grading Insights: Compare graded vs. ungraded market values to help decide if grading (e.g., mint, near-mint) is worth it.

User-Friendly Interface: Clean, intuitive design with quick navigation — no jargon, just a smooth experience.

Never miss a good trade or overpay again — Omi ~ TCG Card Value Scanner keeps you informed and in control.
Download Omi ~ TCG Card Value Scanner today and take your collecting to the next level. With all these features in one place, Omi ~ TCG Card Value Scanner gives you a card price guide, collection tracker, and deck builder in a single app. Happy scanning and trading!
